title: Humphry Davy's birth chart
metaDescription: Humphry Davy's chart, computed from a sourced birth date: Sun at 25.8° Sagittarius. Birth time unknown, so no houses or rising sign.
lede: 0.4° separates Mars and Uranus from an exact trine; at that range drive and disruption read as one mechanism. A trine runs downhill — the talent that never announces itself because it never had to.

blocks.title: Where the Sun actually stood
blocks.text: The Sun's position resolves to 25.8° Sagittarius — deep enough in the third decan (20°–30°) that the Sun, its traditional sub-ruler, colours the reading.

blocks.title: The fast planets
blocks.text: Day to day the chart speaks through Mercury in Capricorn (10.7°), Venus in Capricorn (24.5°), Mars in Libra (16.9°): thought with its feet on the ground, attraction that grows by reliability, effort aimed through strategy and words.

blocks.title: The angles that hold
blocks.text: The tightest geometry in the chart puts Mars a third of the circle apart from Uranus, 0.4° off exact. A trine runs downhill — the talent that never announces itself because it never had to. Behind it, the Sun square Jupiter at 0.5°, and Neptune trine Pluto at 1.0° — both still well inside the orbs this site uses. All of it stands whatever the hour was: each angle was tested from midnight to midnight before it was written down.

blocks.title: What the angles build
blocks.text: The Moon makes no major aspect that survives the day; the old reading gives such a planet autonomy — it acts alone, sometimes loudly.

blocks.title: The classical map
blocks.text: The dignity table, which predates the outer planets and only ever spoke for seven, marks two placements here. Mars in Libra at 16.9° is in detriment — the planet opposite its home, working against the grain; Jupiter in Virgo at 26.2° is in detriment. The table describes circumstance rather than quality — a planet in detriment is inconvenienced, not diminished.

blocks.title: The shape of the whole
blocks.text: Of the 10 placements whose signs hold for the whole day: 4 in air, 3 in earth, 2 in fire, 1 in water by element, 4 mutable, 4 cardinal, 2 fixed by modality. Air runs on comparison and connection — the pattern noticed first, the feeling filed second. Uranus was retrograde. Venus changed direction during the day, so its motion is left open.

blocks.title: The Moon, and how far it can move
blocks.text: The Moon stayed in Sagittarius for the whole of that day at the birthplace, covering 11.8° between midnight and midnight. Fast enough that its degree is approximate, slow enough that its sign is not in doubt. At the noon reference it stands at 10.5°.
